title: MeshSync Thumbnails Extension
description: Thumbnail and preview resource references generated by worker-thumbnail-generation

v1.description: Deprecated pre-2.0 thumbnails schema. Values are prefixed hashes, not resource filenames; writers of MeshPack 2.0 archives MUST use v2.

static.description: Resource reference (hash) for a static thumbnail image (e.g., JPEG/PNG)

animated_360.description: Resource reference (hash) for an animated 360-degree preview (e.g., MP4/GIF)

glb_preview.description: Resource reference (hash) for a GLB 3D preview file

v2.description: Version 2 of the thumbnails extension schema. Values are flat resource filenames in resources/.

static.description: Resource filename for a static thumbnail image (e.g., JPEG/PNG)

animated_360.description: Resource filename for an animated 360-degree preview (e.g., MP4/GIF)

glb_preview.description: Resource filename for a GLB 3D preview file
